name: required_savings_rate_with_match_and_salary_growth
question_template: Apply only this fictional scenario-local retirement saving-rate rule. Age is {AGE}, retirement age is {RET_AGE}; contribution years N equal the difference. Salary in year t is S={SALARY} USD times (1+g)^(t-1), g={GROWTH} percent. Current savings B={SAVINGS} USD and all contributions earn r={RETURN} percent per year, compounded annually. At the end of each year t the employee contributes a fixed percent of that year's salary and the employer adds m={MATCH} percent of the same salary; both then compound for N-t years. Target nest egg at retirement is {REPL} percent of year-N salary divided by withdrawal rate w={WDR} percent. Find the employee percent at which compounded savings plus contributions exactly equal the target; if negative, report zero. Use exact arithmetic and round only the final value half up to two decimals.

slots.description: Salary in the final contribution year in USD.
Target nest egg at retirement in USD.
Compounded current savings at retirement in USD.
Signed combined employee plus employer percent of salary needed.

program:
def solve():
    N = P["RET_AGE"] - P["AGE"]
    if N < 1:
        raise ValueError("retirement age must exceed current age")
    S = Q(P["SALARY"])
    g = Q(P["GROWTH"]) / 100
    r = Q(P["RETURN"]) / 100
    B = Q(P["SAVINGS"])
    m = Q(P["MATCH"])
    rep = Q(P["REPL"]) / 100
    w = Q(P["WDR"]) / 100
    final_salary = S * (1 + g) ** (N - 1)
    target = rep * final_salary / w
    fv_savings = B * (1 + r) ** N
    factor = sum((1 + g) ** (t - 1) * (1 + r) ** (N - t) for t in range(1, N + 1))
    combined = (target - fv_savings) / (S * factor) * 100
    employee = combined - m
    if employee < 0:
        employee = Q(0)
    return {
        "final": employee,
        "year_n_salary_usd": final_salary,
        "target_nest_egg_usd": target,
        "savings_future_value_usd": fv_savings,
        "combined_required_percent": combined,
    }
